scope.context: DRW_DxfAttdefSourceContext: requested applyExtrusion option plus inBlock flag
scope.source: Complete ordered body groups, original ASCII spellings and declared version; excludes code-0 marker
scope.callback: Source before finalized addAttDef; BLOCKS pair delayed to accepted ENDBLK
scope.selection: Latched before each record, not re-evaluated during delayed block flush
scope.optOut: No raw construction/copy/source charge; production typed admission retained
scope.optInAdmission: Existing bounded raw-carrier lexical/identity checks can conservatively refuse ambiguous inputs tolerated by the opt-out typed path; not universal acceptance equivalence

research.use: DXF host/application/subclass roles and identification of additional XRECORD/secondary-attribute fields, not a native DWG layout claim
research.remainingProfileGap: Full AcDbXrecord duplicate/multiline/secondary-attribute representation is not qualified by transport or the current minimal typed projection

implementation.sharedDecoder: Noninstalled intern/dxfattdef.h shares existing required-field checks, nested MTEXT column validation/updateAngle and extrusion dispatch; subclass parsing remains production DRW_Attdef/DRW_Attrib
implementation.extrusion: Recorded read option; current DRW_Text::applyExtrusion remains a no-op. No independent geometry transform qualification.
implementation.blockStaging: Single event owns moved finalized typed ATTDEF and raw body; static nothrow-move assertions. No duplicate raw vector or separate typed event.
implementation.applicationRouting: Host before nested MTEXT; once nested payload exists its application groups remain nested, while host XDATA stays on the existing host route. Parser XDATA cursor cleared at application boundary.
implementation.identityFix: Application code 5 captured with selfHandle=false; neither global identity registration nor raw self metadata latch is allowed for such payload values.
implementation.semanticFix: Raw source spellings unchanged; typed appData uses the normal reader string policy. Precharge decode/copy temporaries, then transfer text into retained typed owner.
implementation.publication: No source/typed ATTDEF publication from malformed or dropped blocks; callbacks can throw after an already delivered prefix, but public block scope closes once.
implementation.accountingLimits: Selected raw variants and logical payload/temporary bytes; not all event/container capacity, whole-model RSS, strict CPU time or all process allocation sites

reproducedRegressions.before: Two authored ATTDEF records reuse opaque application code-5 values. Read fails with selections=2, source=0, typed=0, error=10 before block flush.
reproducedRegressions.after: Both source/typed pairs delivered in order after valid footer; request changes during first callback do not suppress already-selected second pair.
reproducedRegressions.baselineEvidence: Direct CTest output during this slice; no separate immutable baseline log claimed

reproducedRegressions.after: Both read paths and shared replay agree; original raw groups and ASCII spellings remain literal

owningControls.typedChecks: Finalized source/typed snapshots, opt-out and shared decoder replay. Selected common/TEXT/ATTRIB/ATTDEF/nested-MTEXT fields and full authored appData variants; not every public/native-only field.
owningControls.malformed: Missing outer-loop text/tag/Y/height despite opaque poison fields; invalid ENDBLK owner after staged complete child
owningControls.extra: Per-record delayed selection, dropped scope, source/typed throw with no later pair, balanced block closure and corrected same-facade reads
owningControls.quotaFixture: One AC1032 ASCII embedded-MTEXT block with host/nested escaped-Unicode application data
owningControls.allocationScope: Every allocation from source-selection arming through staging, callback publication and read completion for this one authored fixture. A failed callback can expose a prefix, never typed-before-source or an unbalanced block.
